verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਬਿਸਮ ਸ੍ਰਬੰਗ ਮੈ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal makara(n)dh ras lubhit hui a(n)g a(n)g bisam sraba(n)g mai samaane hai ||

en.bdb: The loving disciples of the True Guru whose every limb of the body is intoxicated in the elixir-like Naam of the Lord remain absorbed in the Lord whose form is awesome and enrapturing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਲਿਵ ਦੀਪਕ ਪਤੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨਾਦ ਹੁਇ ਹਿਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhirasaT dharas liv dheepak pata(n)g sa(n)g sabadh surat mirag naadh hui hiraane hai ||

en.bdb: Devotee's mind is akin to a moth who is always absorbed in love of light. Like a deer, enchanted by certain sounds, the devotee remains engrossed in the unstruck music by practicing Naam Simran.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਾਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਨਿਰਲੋਭ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਨਿਰਮੋਹ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਹੰੂ ਲਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kaam nihakaam krodhaakrodh niralobh lobh moh niramoh aha(n)mev ha(n)oo lajaane hai ||

en.bdb: A Guru-oriented Sikh is free from the effects of lust, anger, avarice, attachment and shy of pride and other vices.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਸਚਰਜੈ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਅਦਭੁਤ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਅਸਥਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੨੯੩॥
verses.translit_en: bisamai bisam asacharajai asacharaj mai adhabhut paramadhabhut asathaane hai ||293||

en.bdb: The mind of Guru-conscious and practitioners of Naam resides in the mystical tenth door. This is a place that is full of ecstasy, astonishing beyond astonishments and most amazing. (293)
